verdict.rationale: Together AI documents a dedicated asynchronous batch API for running bulk inference workloads at lower cost, directly enabling bulk operations across many items (e.g., many prompts) in one job. Combined with per-token pricing on 100+ models and no provisioning latency, this supports scaling bulk requests, though details on max batch size, job monitoring, and independent hands-on validation are absent. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on verification of batch job scale and reliability, documentation on batch size limits and error handling for large-scale bulk runs.
